scope: FSSR Chapter 2.3 source-identity and analytical evidence gates for three previously source-screened but still legally unadjudicated product categories; no product pass.

product_cases.name: Frozen Fruits/Fruit Products
product_cases.product_definition: Sound, clean, mature fruit, block-frozen or individually quick-frozen, washed and blanched where required; product reaches −18°C at thermal centre after thermal stabilization
specific_evidence: Fruit species/plant part and whole or cut food form
Block/IQF process and stabilized core-temperature chart
Blanching applicability and actual execution if required
Milk-solids or other allergen ingredient declarations
Appendix B, additives and current correct CTR sample matrix
product_cases.wrong_article_guard: Frozen fruit is not canned/thermally processed fruit, raw fruit or fruit pulp just by name; frozen-fruit standard has no blanket peroxidase-negative requirement

product_cases.name: Seedless Tamarind
product_cases.product_definition: Tamarindus indica L. ripe fruit after removal of seeds and outer covering; free of infestation, mould and specified foreign matter
specific_evidence: Actual Tamarindus indica identity and seed/covering removal
Six tests with correct dry-weight basis on ash and crude fibre
Appendix B microbiological panel and correct current CTR article
product_cases.wrong_article_guard: Seedless tamarind is not tamarind pulp/puree/concentrate (FSSR 2.3.18); do not borrow that standard's Brix/acidity/ash values

product_cases.name: Quick Frozen Fried Potatoes
product_cases.product_definition: Strips of permitted potato or sweet potato species, fried/precooked in edible oil or fat or water-blanched before freezing; −18°C at thermal centre after stabilization
specific_evidence: Exact species Solanum tuberosum, Solanum andigena or Ipomoea batatas
Frying/precooking in permitted fat/oil or water blanch step
Core temperature and piece-size frozen-condition measurements
Moisture, FFA as oleic acid in extracted fat, burnt units mass fraction
Additives, batter/allergens, Appendix B and correct current CTR species/processed-product scope
product_cases.wrong_article_guard: Not automatically raw potatoes, canned vegetables or unspecified residual Other vegetables; water-blanched permitted process does not automatically prove the product was fried

critical_legality_guards: Frozen fruits blanching is conditional ('if required'); do not treat mandatory negative peroxidase for frozen vegetables 2.3.38 as an automatic frozen-fruit requirement.
Frozen-fruit and quick-frozen fried-potato core temperature −18°C refers to thermal centre after thermal stabilization, not merely air or blast freezer set point.
Seedless tamarind is actual de-seeded fruit, not sieved tamarind pulp or concentrate; total ash, AIA and fibre use dry basis, organic extraneous matter and residual seeds use their printed w/w basis.
The 2.3.60 standard expressly permits sweet potato and water-blanched processing; the title alone does not establish actual frying process or allow unconditional raw potato/vegetable CTR limits.
The 4mm potato-strip minimum applies to strips cut on all four sides and measured when frozen; particular width designations need separate correct label/style check.
The underlying 2025 reference compendium is newer than earlier R46/R47 2024 source copies; those prior records require a separately scoped edition-diff check before any legal rule activation.

None of the three Food Product Standards identities determines the complete current original-Gazette CTR metal/pesticide/toxin panel, packaging/additive rules, microbiological results, or commercial release by itself.
